add_en: Rear dip switches let the DSP adapt to a desk, a wall or corner placement.
Tight lows and snarling mids slice through loud guitars; palm mutes stay percussive.
add_es: Graves ajustados y medios gruñones cortan entre guitarras.

add_en: Its USB audio interface records at 44.1 kHz/24-bit alongside 256-note polyphony.
add_es: Su interfaz de audio USB graba a 44,1 kHz/24 bit.

add_en: Eight AA batteries and 13.1 kg keep it portable, with unbalanced outs for a house PA.
add_es: Con ocho pilas AA pesa solo 13,1 kg.

add_en: It offers up to 24 surgical EQ bands and a clear spectrum analyzer.
add_es: Ofrece hasta 24 bandas de EQ quirúrgica y analizador clarísimo.

add_en: A matching bridge J pickup and active preamp with S-1 switching add hum-free flexibility.
add_es: Incluye pastilla J de puente y previo activo.

add_en: On the mix bus it adds several decibels of loudness that translate.
add_es: En el bus añade varios decibelios de sonoridad real.

add_en: Direct-to-stand mounting is included, although the SwiftShield shockmount is sold separately.
add_es: El montaje al pie va incluido; el SwiftShield no.

add_en: It runs as VST2, VST3, AU and AAX on macOS and Windows.
add_es: Funciona en VST2, VST3, AU y AAX.

add_en: The onboard preamp shapes bass and treble, giving hotter output and quick tweaks.
add_es: El previo integrado aporta salida y retoques rápidos.

add_en: Two preamps reach +56 dB, with 24-bit/192 kHz conversion and loopback for capture.

add_es: En cabinas de guitarra distorsionada su caída natural de agudos doma la dureza.

add_en: The single-coils deliver bridge growl and neck warmth, with noise possible under neon.
add_es: Sus single-coils dan gruñido de puente y calidez.

add_en: It sends a consistent signal to the desk for acoustic instruments on stage.
add_es: Es una caja práctica para instrumentos acústicos.

add_en: The fan adds length to lower strings while upper strings stay bendable.
add_es: El abanico alarga las cuerdas graves.

add_en: Strong isolation keeps the mix out of the mic, with coiled, long and short cables.
Macros, arpeggiators, chord and scale modes plus MIDI DIN I/O expand control.
add_es: Macros, arpegios y modos de acordes amplían el control.

add_en: High output suits modest preamps, with 131 dB of dynamic range.
add_es: Su alta salida favorece previos modestos.

add_en: The Class-A circuit uses no ICs, and 611 g of metal feels substantial.
add_es: Su circuito Clase A no usa circuitos integrados.

add_en: Parameter locks bring grooves alive, and the 800-gram chassis is pure synthesis.
Seven Onyx preamps supply clean gain, and GigFX adds reverbs, delays and chorus.
add_es: Siete previos Onyx dan ganancia limpia.

add_en: Rated from 200 Hz to 4 kHz, they target midrange smear, not bass.
Transient precision and low-end extension come with 612 grams and an amplifier appetite.
Self-noise is 20 dB SPL, with a pivoting mount and soft pouch but no shock mount.
The binding and passive volume-volume-tone wiring reinforce the seventies look.
add_es: El binding refuerza su aire setentero.

add_en: Tone Capture samples existing gear, and the tri-voice synth needs no special pickup.
